title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view in the Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard
summary: Hold: the briefing sends administrators to a settings page for an exclusion-list path that the page does not provide. The dashboard's licensing, defaults and printed controls are supported; Microsoft also gives conflicting role guidance for web-app access management.
